result.rationale: The migration in db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb interpolates the migrated host value directly into SQL: `INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`. Values come from the old `embeddable_hosts` site setting, which was free-form text (the removed setting's docs said 'Hostname only', but nothing enforced it), so a value containing a quote would break the migration. This is a real, verifiable defect in the diff, though its severity is limited to migration robustness on sites with unusual saved values.

adjudication.rationale: The migration `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` interpolates host strings directly into raw SQL: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. If `h` contains a single quote (or other SQL-significant characters), it will break the SQL and can cause the migration to fail (and is also an injection risk). This is directly verifiable from the diff.
